relations.subject: Masatoshi Nagatomi
relations.evidence: He later transferred to Kyoto University where he received his B.A. in Indian Philosophy and Buddhism.

relations.subject: Masatoshi Nagatomi
relations.evidence: Upon settling down in Cambridge, Massachusetts, he was accepted into Harvard University. In 1957, he received his Ph.D.

relations.subject: Masatoshi Nagatomi
relations.evidence: In 1957, he received his Ph.D. under the supervision of Sanskrit scholar Daniel Ingalls.

relations.subject: Masatoshi Nagatomi
relations.evidence: In 1958, Masatoshi joined the faculty at Harvard as Instructor of Sanskrit.

relations.subject: Masatoshi Nagatomi
relations.evidence: In 1969 he was appointed Harvard's first full-time Professor of Buddhist Studies. With a thirty-eight year tenure

relations.subject: Masatoshi Nagatomi
relations.evidence: In 1986, Nagatomi founded the Harvard Buddhist Studies Forum.
